name_note: GTDB splits classical Streptococcus salivarius into several species and this is one of them, so published findings about S. salivarius cover a broader group than s__Streptococcus salivarius_E.

sentences.text: Streptococcus salivarius is a gram-positive viridans group streptococcus that primarily colonizes the oral cavity and gastrointestinal tract and is generally regarded as a benign commensal organism.
Invasive infections have been reported, but they typically occur in immunocompromised hosts or following invasive gastrointestinal or spinal procedures.
A systematic review that included 15 citations reported that three strains used as probiotics, M18, K-12 and 24SMB, all demonstrated positive benefits in pediatric pathology.
In a multicentre randomised placebo-controlled trial in New Zealand that randomised 428 children, doctor-recorded acute otitis media occurred in 39% of placebo and 37% of probiotic recipients.
